question: Who became the first Viceroy of India?
solution: The correct answer is __**Lord Canning.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • In **1856**,** Lord Canning** succeeded** Lord Dalhousie **as** Governor-General of India.** • From **1856 to 1862**, Lord Canning was the Governor General of India. • During his reign, the** Government of India Act of 1858** was passed, establishing the **post of Viceroy**, which was to be held by the same person who held the position of Governor-General of India. • As a result, Lord Canning also served as** India's first Viceroy.** • **The Revolt of 1857** began when Lord Canning was just in his second year as Governor-General of India. As a result, he had to deal with it and make every attempt to conquer it.
